items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: It was a wonderful tour. It really was.
You mentioned [Erickson?]. This is the only band I ever been in that got a standing ovation every night. And he was right. That’s what happened. Every night we got a standing ovation.

It was more like theater, in a way. You go to see The Fantas- – that’s what I said. The Fantasticks. I don’t know if you remember it. It was a little play off Broadway that played for about 20 years, different casts, over and over. But the music . . .
